messages:
mia: Heads up — I'm wiring up the Console quickstart for A/B experiments. Quick Q: what should the safe defaults be for new experiments' traffic guard? Thinking 1% seed -> 10% target over ~6h, with automatic rollbacks on p99 regresses. Any input? :wave:

alex: +1 on being conservative. I prefer 1% seed, ramp to 10% in 3 steps (1%, 3%, 10%) each ~2h. Important: enforce per-variant qps cap and a fallback model variant if errors > 0.5% for 10m. Also add metric gating for >10%.

sam: Ops ask that auto-ramp beyond 20% must be manual. Can we make a 'soft ramp' vs 'hard ramp' toggle in the wizard? Soft ramp continues with monitoring, hard ramp pauses and needs explicit confirm.

jordan: From API side: note we support two routing modes: "weight" (probabilistic) and "shard" (deterministic keyed). For quickstart we should surface "weight" and an optional sticky key (session_id, user_id). If sticky_key set, routing should use consistent hashing.

deploy-bot: canary-rule-checker: simulated run — missing explicit fallback_variant configured for experiment 'mia/console-quickstart'. recommend adding fallback on create to avoid blackholing.

alex: example default payload we could use:
```
{
  "seed": 0.01,
  "target": 0.10,
  "steps": [0.01, 0.03, 0.10],
  "step_duration": "2h",
  "auto_rollbacks": {"p99_latency_inc_pct": 30, "error_rate_pct": 0.5},
  "routing_mode": "weight",
  "sticky_key": null
}
```

sam: telemetry checklist for unblocking ramp >10%: p99 latency, error rate (5xx), model-quality metric (regression on evaluation set), and fallback-trigger logs. Also expose these on the experiment dashboard with a 'safety status' indicator.

mia: ok i'll implement defaults: 1% seed, 10% target, 3-step 2h ramp, soft gating at 20% requires manual confirmation, default routing mode=weight, show sticky key toggle, and require telemetry baseline before >10%. i'll open a PR with UI mock and api contract. Thanks! :tada:
